description.ja: 孫悟空がパッケージをリニューアルして登場！！
description.en: Son Goku is now available with a renewed package! !

description.ja: 人造人間との決戦に向け修行を積んだ悟空が登場！マッスルをビルドせよ！
description.en: Goku, who has been training for a decisive battle with Androids, appears! Build muscle!

description.ja: ■表情パーツは、「通常」「怒り」に加え「笑顔」の3種類の表情パーツが付属！
description.en: ■ Three types of facial expression parts are included: "normal ", " angry ", and " smiling"!

description.ja: 戦闘中の悟空はもちろん、普段の無邪気な悟空も再現可能に！
description.en: Not only Goku in battle, but also the innocent Goku in everyday life can be recreated!

description.ja: ■エフェクトパーツには新規造形でかめはめ波のパーツを付属！かめはめ波の一連の動作が再現可能に！
description.en: ■Effect parts include Kamehameha parts with new modeling! The series of movements of Kamehameha can now be reproduced!

accessories.ja: ハンドパーツ4種類（6個：握り、開き、瞬間移動、手刀※挨拶）
accessories.en: 4 types of hand parts (6 pieces: grip, opening, instantaneous movement, hand sword *greeting)

accessories.ja: かめはめ波（溜め）エフェクト
かめはめ波（放出）エフェクト
表情3種類（平常、叫び、笑顔）
accessories.en: 3 types of facial expressions (normal, screaming, smiling)
